name: Stage 33:1: Kvarsebo färja to Brytsebo
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 33:1, Kvarsebo färja to Brytsebo.
utilities: Kvarsebo/Säter ferry landing has parking and seasonal cafe context; Brytsebo/Skvättan has reserve parking with about 7 spaces. Public transport is sparse: current checks point to Östgötatrafiken line 902 on schooldays only, while the official stage-page bus 432 note appears stale.

No grocery, reliable drinking-water refill, or guaranteed year-round service was verified directly on the stage. Cafe Säterdalen and Qvarsebo/Kvarsebo village services are seasonal or opening-hour dependent; do not treat them as dependable resupply without a live check.
waterSources: No official potable water source on stage 33:1. Carry water.

Skyttholmens shelter has shelter/fire/toilet context but no verified potable water, and the mapped dry toilet explicitly has no drinking-water tag. Bråviken is brackish sea/inlet water, not a drinking-water source.
The nearest official trail spring is Ålkärrsdrogen on stage 33, not on this access connector and not convenient for a short 33:1 trip.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 4 km. Naturkartan renders about 3.6 km, AllTrails about 3.7 km, and OSM relation 3696342 measures about 3.8 km. If you continue from the 33:1/33 junction to the Stage 33/34 Brytsebo board, add about 0.37 km along Stage 33, giving roughly 4.2 km.

This is an access/connector stage from Kvarsebo/Säter ferry to the Stage 33 junction near Brytsebo, linking Sörmlandsleden with Östgötaleden/Europaled 6. It should not be treated as a mainline continuation or as directly sharing a node with Stage 34.

Short does not mean easy: the route is steep/rocky with several brants, hällmark, major Bråviken views, blue side spurs to bathing cliffs/jättegrytor, Rövargrottan, and a demanding initial climb from the ferry that older trip reports found slightly hard to follow in lush growth. A 2023 user comment described the stage as very nice and well maintained, so keep the route-finding note as seasonal/older evidence rather than a current fault.

Official Sörmlandsleden page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-27 research pass. Recent official comments describe the route as very hilly but beautiful; older trip reports mention route-finding/overgrowth near the ferry, not confirmed as a current fault. A nearby 2021 group walk around Kvarsebo/Klint also supports the hands-on steepness with rope/ladder context in the local terrain.

Skenäsleden ferry is free across Bråviken between Skenäs and Säter/Kvarsebo, but time it carefully. Trafikverket says be present at the scheduled Skenäs departure time even from the Säter/Kvarsebo side; if nobody is waiting at either landing, the ferry may not run. Check Trafikverket/Färjerederiet live status.

Bråvikenbranten reserve rules: tenting max two consecutive nights in the same place, dogs leashed, fires only at Länsstyrelsen-signed grill places, no damaging living/dead trees or rock/ground, no collecting mosses/lichens/non-edible fungi, and climbing requires permit. There was no regional fire ban in checked official sources on 2026-04-27, but RTÖG showed a same-day forest-fire incident in Norrköping, so always check live fire risk and emergency status.

Östgötaleden is messy here: official Östgötaleden text says it follows Sörmlandsleden 31:1, 32, 33 and 33:1 to the Säter/Kvarsebo ferry, while OSM relation 6124617 uses Stage 33 plus road/ferry geometry and does not include all Stage 33:1 forest-path ways. For this app, draw the Sörmlandsleden 33:1 forest connector and treat Östgötaleden as an overlapping/variant label rather than duplicate physical trail.

Rövargrottan cave entry is at your own risk; bring a flashlight/headlamp and avoid wet/icy or solo entry, heavy packs, and small children. Nearby Kopparbogrottan is more serious and not recommended for inexperienced visitors.

Literary context: official material references Almqvist and Hans Lidman's I Tintomaras spar for the Kolmården/Bråviken landscape. Treat generated/geographic claims about Kvarsebosjön or Brytsebosjön as unreliable; the route context is Bråviken.

facilities.name: Kvarsebo/Säter ferry landing
facilities.description: Official stage start by the north/Säter side of Trafikverket's Skenäsleden ferry. Parking and seasonal cafe context nearby; check ferry live status before planning around it.

facilities.name: Säter ferry terminal
facilities.description: OSM ferry terminal at the Kvarsebo/Säter side. Hiking sources often call this Kvarsebo färja, while Trafikverket names the route Skenäsleden, Skenäs-Säter.

facilities.name: Skenäsleden ferry
facilities.description: Free road ferry over Bråviken between Skenäs and Säter/Kvarsebo, about 1020 m and roughly 5 minutes. Be present at the scheduled Skenäs departure time even from the Säter side; if nobody waits at either landing, the ferry may not run.

facilities.name: Skenäs-side ferry toilet
facilities.description: OSM-mapped toilet on the south/Skenäs side of the ferry, across Bråviken from the 33:1 trail start. Useful for ferry logistics, but opening/condition is not guaranteed and it is not on the 33:1 trail side.

facilities.name: Kvarsebo ferry parking
facilities.description: Parking at/near the ferry landing; verify local signs and ferry/cafe seasonal traffic.

facilities.name: Cafe Säterdalen
facilities.description: Seasonal cafe by the ferry area; opening hours not reliably verified, so do not rely on it without checking.

facilities.name: Säterholmsvägen bus access
facilities.description: Useful bus access for the start-side/mid-route area. Current checks point to line 902, valid timetable period 2025-12-14 to 2026-06-14, schooldays only and no weekend service in the PDF; verify live departures.

facilities.name: Kvarsebo affär bus access
facilities.description: Kvarsebo village bus access, but about 2 km from the route/start area. Current line 902 service is sparse/schooldays; older bus 432 text appears stale and should not be used without live-planner confirmation.

facilities.name: Qvarsebo Kaffe seasonal context
facilities.description: Roastery/cafe/local-shop context in Kvarsebo village, more than 2 km from much of the route and with variable seasonal opening. Useful context, not dependable route resupply without checking.

facilities.name: Högudden / Bråviken viewpoint
facilities.description: High scenic viewpoint area over Bråviken; official text highlights the brants and broad views.

facilities.name: Högudden cape
facilities.description: Named cape/locality below the main Högudden viewpoint. Use the viewpoint marker for the main bench/view stop.

facilities.name: Jättegrytor side trail
facilities.description: Blue-marked side trail to giant-kettle geology near Högudden; slippery/exposed rock possible. Exact side-spur line should be treated as approximate.

facilities.name: Bråvikenbranten cliff bathing spot
facilities.description: Small cliff-bathing side spot along the Bråvikenbranten stretch, reported by local outdoor guide sources. Access is steep/advanced and this is not a serviced beach or drinking-water point.

facilities.name: Rövargrottan cave
facilities.description: Small cave with tight/rope-assisted entry context. Enter at own risk, bring a flashlight/headlamp, avoid wet/icy conditions, heavy packs and solo entry.

facilities.name: Örnbergsgrottan side cave
facilities.description: OSM/secondary-source cave near the ferry/start area. May sit slightly off the main 33:1 line; treat as a nearby side POI and rely on local signs/conditions before visiting.

facilities.name: Bränningsbergen high point
facilities.description: Named high point/terrain marker above Bråvikenbranten. Scenic/route-character context rather than a serviced facility.

facilities.name: Kopparbogrottan safety caveat
facilities.description: Nearby cave system with deep cracks, tight passages and often water; Länsstyrelsen says it is not recommended for inexperienced visitors and never go alone. Not a casual stage facility.

facilities.name: Skyttholmens brygga / Bråviken shelter
facilities.description: Small shelter/rest point near Bråviken, about 4 sleeping places. Sources report benches, fireplace/grill, dry toilet nearby, picnic/rest function and firewood context, but current condition and firewood availability are not guaranteed.

facilities.name: Skyttholmens brygga dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry/bucket toilet near the shelter; mapped as no drinking water, with no handwashing or paper guarantees.

facilities.name: Skyttholmens brygga fireplace
facilities.description: Prepared fireplace/grill context near the shelter. Use only if current fire rules allow; inside Bråvikenbranten fires are only at Länsstyrelsen-signed grill places.

facilities.name: Skyttholmen lower fire/rest spot
facilities.description: Second mapped lower beach/firepit/rest context below the shelter. Treat as a local rest/fire point only if signed on site and current reserve/fire-ban rules allow.

facilities.name: Bråvikenbranten reserve rules
facilities.description: Reserve rules: tent max two nights in same place, dogs leashed, fires only at signed grill places, no damaging trees/dead wood/rock/ground, no collecting mosses/lichens/non-edible fungi, climbing needs permit, and check fire risk.

facilities.name: Skvättan/Bråvikenbranten parking
facilities.description: Reserve parking near the Brytsebo end, about 7 spaces with information boards/picnic context. Also useful for stage 33/34 access; do not assume overflow roadside parking.

facilities.name: Marielundsvägen bus access
facilities.description: Best researched bus access for the Brytsebo/Skvättan end. Länsstyrelsen says school-day bus between Krokek and Kvarsebo, about 600 m walk to reserve entrance; verify line 902 live.

facilities.name: Stage 33:1 junction near Brytsebo
facilities.description: Topological end of OSM Stage 33:1 where it meets Stage 33. To reach the Stage 33/34 Brytsebo board, continue about 0.37 km along Stage 33 toward 58.651099, 16.551060. Nearby parking is at Brytsebo/Skvättan, not necessarily at this junction.

facilities.name: Brytsebo Stage 33/34 board
facilities.description: Stage 33/34 shared Brytsebo board area, reached from Stage 33:1 by adding a short Stage 33 connector of about 0.37 km. Use this marker for continuation to Stage 34, not as the raw 33:1 relation endpoint.
